brutalistIdentity: Pure-black ink used for foreground AND borders AND inputs (#000) — the defining move. Hard offset drop-shadow: `3px 3px 0px 0.5px` solid black, ZERO blur (`--shadow-x/y:3px`, `--shadow-blur:0px`). Thin (1–1.5px) hard black hairlines everywhere (`--se-color-line`). Boxy near-square radius (`--radius:4px`, card 8px). Type: Inter (sans) + JetBrains Mono (mono) + Merriweather (serif); signature = UPPERCASE mono micro-labels with wide tracking (0.08–0.12em) and heavy 700–900 weights. Big score numerals via `clamp(3rem, min(22vh,26vw), 8rem)`. Open borderless typographic tap-zones for scoring (no card, press flashes accent — `.mono-arena-half`, `.mono-scorer-run-button`). Off-white faint-green canvas `#F1F4EF`; green reserved strictly for lead/emphasis, not decoration. Tokens flow oklch → `--se-*` semantic aliases → CSS classes (src/index.css :root, mono.css).
hifiTraits: Everything rounded — 99px capsule/pill buttons, 50% circular tap targets, 10–16px soft cards, no square corners. Circular/capsule scoring controls (tap a big soft target, not tiny +/- steppers). Plain-language micro-copy prompts on every scorer ("Tap a side to score", "Tap who won the rally", "Tap the point winner") — the UI asks a question. Big friendly celebratory numerals (60–104px). Soft green warmth: green-tint washes (`#e7f4ee`), warm-green-black shadows (`rgba(20,40,30,…)` never pure black), gold (`#b8862e`/`#e8b64c`) for wins/MVP/milestones. Green glow colored shadows on primary CTAs. Gentle breathing LIVE pulse animations (opacity/glow, 1.2–1.8s) instead of harsh blink. Contextual coaching caption chips ("break point", "set point soon", "Need 73 off 44", "RRR", "BONUS"). Post-event attribution bottom-sheets (who/how) each with Skip + Confirm. Undo-last-ball affordance. Share-live QR sheet. Dedicated read-only spectator views + match graphs/momentum. Designed empty/first-run states. Bottom tab nav (Home · Play · History · Friends/More).

gaps: Shared token + component layer: styling is a 3-way hybrid (mono.css semantic classes + inline Tailwind v4 utilities + one-off inline styles with hardcoded hex like color:'#111'/'#'). Need a single token system that bridges the brutalist oklch tokens with the HiFi friendly-mode traits (rounded radii scale, pill/circle controls, soft green washes, gold, colored/glow shadows) so both aesthetics compose instead of fighting. This is the foundation everything else sits on.

Real-time / live / spectator infrastructure is MISSING from production — LiveBroadcastBar, LiveMatchCard, LiveNowStrip, ShareLiveMatch, ReportMatch and convex/live.ts exist ONLY in a .claude/worktrees/wf_* branch. Spectator mode, share-live-link+QR, and the live social feed all depend on landing this backend + UI in src/ and convex/ first.
No Result / Scorecard / Share-card surface — the entire match-end flow (FULL TIME → Done/Rematch/Share/Scorecard) is absent; scorers currently have no designed terminal state.

Post-event attribution depth — AppScoringPrompt exists but the full HiFi sheets (assist/own-goal, dismissal type, winner vs forced vs unforced vs double-fault) with Skip+Confirm are not built, and there is no stats pipeline consuming them into player/team records.
No visualization layer at all — match graphs, momentum/worm, box score, per-sport spectator graphs, statistics trends/head-to-head. Statistics is table-only.
No Settings screen and dark mode declared-but-unused — scoring defaults (incl. Confirm wicket/goal toggle), auto-share default, appearance/dark toggle, data export/clear all have nowhere to live.
Entire social layer missing — Activity feed, Friends list, Find & invite, Notifications, public player profiles with add-friend, friend/mutual counts.
Entire teams-management flow missing (My teams / Create team / Add players / Roster) despite Convex teams tables existing.
Empty / first-run states undesigned — HiFi explicitly designs Home-empty, Teams-empty, History-empty; app renders zero-grids or perpetual-loading (I-053) instead.
Team-only (anonymous, no-roster) casual mode not supported by any scorer.

Monolith decomposition — MonoQuickMatch.jsx (2850 ln) and MonoTournamentSetup.jsx (1838 ln) conflate setup+scoring+dispatch, driving I-085 duplicate cricket start paths; must be split before clean HiFi Setup/Toss/Customize screens can be built.
Legacy orphan reconciliation — MonoHome, MonoSetup, NewUserFlow, MonoSportHome_TABBED are unwired dead-weight to delete/merge.

Bottom-nav information architecture — current tabs are Play/History/Stats (with I-066 Stats-vs-Statistics label mismatch); HiFi tab model is Home · Play · History · Friends/More, which requires the new Home, Friends and Settings surfaces to exist.

Design-debt cleanup carried in-code (I-044 tiny fonts, I-047 uneven CTA tap feedback, I-049 disabled-looking controls, I-051/I-052 non-uniform score buttons, I-068 ad-hoc green 4/6 accent, I-086 filter-heavy mobile history) — verify open status in kernel before re-fixing; several already have fix-comments shipped.
